verzen.tekst: Hear this, all you peoples.
verzen.html: Hear this, all you peoples.

verzen.tekst: both low and high,
verzen.html: both low and high,

verzen.tekst: My mouth will speak words of wisdom.
verzen.html: My mouth will speak words of wisdom.

verzen.tekst: I will incline my ear to a proverb.
verzen.html: I will incline my ear to a proverb.

verzen.tekst: Why should I fear in the days of evil,
verzen.html: Why should I fear in the days of evil,

verzen.tekst: Those who trust in their wealth,
verzen.html: Those who trust in their wealth,

verzen.tekst: none of them can by any means redeem his brother,
verzen.html: none of them can by any means redeem his brother,

verzen.tekst: For the redemption of their life is costly,
verzen.html: For the redemption of their life is costly,

verzen.tekst: that he should live on forever,
verzen.html: that he should live on forever,

verzen.tekst: For he sees that wise men die;
verzen.html: For he sees that wise men die;

verzen.tekst: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever,
verzen.html: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever,

verzen.tekst: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure.
verzen.html: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure.

verzen.tekst: This is the destiny of those who are foolish,
verzen.html: This is the destiny of those who are foolish,

verzen.tekst: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol.
verzen.html: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol.

voetnoten.tekst: Sheol is the place of the dead.

verzen.tekst: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol,
verzen.html: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol,

voetnoten.tekst: Sheol is the place of the dead.

verzen.tekst: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich,
verzen.html: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich,

verzen.tekst: for when he dies he will carry nothing away.
verzen.html: for when he dies he will carry nothing away.

verzen.tekst: Though while he lived he blessed his soul—
verzen.html: Though while he lived he blessed his soul—

verzen.tekst: he shall go to the generation of his fathers.
verzen.html: he shall go to the generation of his fathers.

verzen.tekst: A man who has riches without understanding,
